Overrides the width of the composition.

## CLI flag

Use `--width` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                 | Flag              |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------- |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                   | `--width <value>` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)                     | `--width <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)             | `--width <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)     | `--width <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)       | `--width <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render) | `--width <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun still`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/still)   | `--width <value>` |
